origin.description: True when the pager R would use answers --version with a less version line.
origin.details: With the default options(pager), this reads PAGER. R's Renviron fills PAGER when it is unset. A bare name is tested as a path, not searched on PATH.

translation.description: The same check. An unset PAGER uses the default from R_HOME/etc/Renviron.
translation.details: The program must be an executable file. The first line of --version must match less followed by a space and a digit.
